comment: Caller-context fixture for the reusable core-wheel workflow (MOR-4408): a private caller whose repository and sha are NOT rigplane/rigplane-core's, invoking the workflow twice in one run with different refs and artifact prefixes. The pins built on this fixture prove the workflow's checkouts, CORE_REMOTE and controls never derive from the caller (in a called workflow github.repository and github.sha belong to the CALLER), and that two invocations cannot collide on artifact names. The quote in the first core_ref is a legal git ref name character and doubles as the JSON-escaping fixture for core-wheel.json.
